snippet.title: Midnight Gameplay Reveal | World of Warcraft
snippet.description:
As darkness threatens to envelop all of Azeroth every hero must rise to defy the Void and take up arms. Get your first look at the gameplay reveal of the next chapter of the Worldsoul Saga, World of Warcraft: Midnight
